name: Centrifugal and axial compressors
principle: A spinning impeller adds energy to a continuous gas flow; a diffuser turns the kinetic energy into static pressure. In oil and gas they drive pipelines, refining, gas processing and reinjection.

process_steps.name: Gas enters through inlet and guide vanes
Impeller adds energy to the flow
Collector or volute delivers gas downstream
